subject: Compliance onramp: MAP with evidence owners, SLAs & retention carveouts
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Maya Singh <maya.singh@acme-payments.com>, Peter Zhou <peter.zhou@acme-payments.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: New MAP: security onramp, evidence owners, and retention carveouts

Hi Maya / Peter —

Thanks again for the thoughtful kickoff yesterday. As promised, attached is a first draft of a Mutual Action Plan focused on the security/compliance gates you flagged (SOC 2, SIG/CAIQ, DPA redlines, and data retention windows). High level:

- Goal: get to contract signature + production onboarding within 6 weeks, with security evidence and DPA negotiated in parallel.
- Key gates: SOC 2 Type II (redacted report), completed SIG/CAIQ questionnaire, DPA signed with retention appendix, and proof of audit logging/retention configuration for PII.

Attachments included: acme_map_v0.3.xlsx (MAP with deadlines & owners), our latest SOC 2 Type II (redacted), and the SIG/CAIQ response workbook. Please review the owners column — we've suggested internal owners but want to align to your legal/security contacts.

Open items for you:
1) Confirm who on your side will own DPA negotiation (legal point-of-contact).
2) Confirm any retention carveouts for EU-sourced data (we've proposed 30 days for logs, 365 days for minimal backups; see tab "Retention Proposal").
3) Any regulatory must-haves we missed for payments (e.g., AES key escrow constraints).

Plan to update the MAP by EOD Wednesday with agreed owners and push a DocuSign request for the SOW+DPA once legal scopes are clarified.

Thanks —
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference

From: Maya Singh <maya.singh@acme-payments.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Peter Zhou <peter.zhou@acme-payments.com>, Acme Payments Legal <legal@acme-payments.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: New MAP: security onramp, evidence owners, and retention carveouts

Thanks Rachel — appreciate the fast turnaround and the level of detail. Quick notes:

- We will own DPA negotiation from our side; looping in legal (copied).
- Retention: for EU-sourced PII we need to aim for 90 days for logs unless there is a contractual justification for longer. For backups, 365 days is acceptable but we need an option to shorten to 180 days if requested by a regulator.
- Please add an explicit milestone for our SIG reviewer to finish the first pass by Nov 18.

I will have legal confirm any unusual clauses by Thursday. Otherwise the MAP looks actionable.

—Maya
Maya Singh
Head of Security Programs
Acme Payments

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 08:32:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: proposed owners & timeline (updates to MAP)

Folks — following Maya's note I updated the MAP and mapped evidence owners. Summary (internal owners + proposed due dates):

- SOC 2 Type II (redacted): Owner = Vivek Kulkarni (deliver redacted PDF + control narrative) — due Nov 17
- SIG/CAIQ response: Owner = Ben Carter (coordinate with QA) — first pass due Nov 18, final Nov 20
- DPA term sheet / retention appendix: Owner = Laura Bennett (legal ops) — initial redline to Acme by Nov 13, final to sign Nov 24
- Logging retention configuration (prod): Owner = Rachel Kim (CS/Onboarding) — provide config screenshots & access plan by Nov 16

Notes:
- I'll spin up a shared Drive folder and drop the SOC 2 artifacts and the SIG workbook. Action item for Laura: flag any non-standard DPA carveouts (e.g., requests to export keys).
- We should offer a temporary SLA exception for 30 days to allow Acme's security to complete validation; update the MAP with that fallback.

I'll push the updated acme_map_v0.4 later today and include a simple GANTT in the timeline tab so legal can see sign-by dates.

Ben

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Maya Singh <maya.singh@acme-payments.com>, Peter Zhou <peter.zhou@acme-payments.com>, Acme Payments Legal <legal@acme-payments.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 16:24:00 -0800
Subject: Re: New MAP: security onramp, evidence owners, and retention carveouts

Hi Maya / team —

Thanks for the quick confirmations. Final update:

- Attached: acme_map_v0.4.xlsx (owners updated), SOC2_TypeII_redacted.pdf (Vivek), SIG-CAIQ-response-2026.xlsx (first pass).
- Laura will send the initial DPA redline to legal@acme-payments.com by EOD Friday (Nov 13).
- We accepted the 90-day EU log retention carveout and added an optional 180-day backup window that can be toggled per regulatory need (see "Retention Appendix" tab).
- DocuSign: we'll queue the SOW + DPA for signature after legal and redlines align (targeting week of Nov 22). Link will be shared in this thread.

Next steps for Acme: confirm a named legal reviewer for the DPA and assign the SIG reviewer by Nov 18. Redwood next steps: finalize SIG responses (Ben), provide SOC 2 evidence (Vivek), and circulate DocuSign bundle once Laura confirms redlines.

If that matches your expectations we'll treat this MAP as the operational plan to close.

Best,
Rachel
